write_up: Your resume points to staff accounting and accounts payable: you process vendor invoices at Bayou Industrial Supply and previously handled the general ledger and financial statements at Minh Phat Trading Company. I read it for Staff Accountant roles. The combination of hands-on US work and earlier accounting experience gives a recruiter a clear story.

The Minh Phat line about reducing the month-end close is the model: it names the change and the checklist and template you made. Your profile names the jobs you want, and your US GAAP certificate and QuickBooks experience are easy to find.

Start with your current role and spell out what you help the controller do at month end. Then add what your junior accountants handled at Minh Phat, so a recruiter can see the work behind the team you led.
